== Description ==
Players Committee sheet for [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds|Virtual Set 6]], marked "Updated 10/12/04" on PDF page 1. The three pages contain Light Side and Dark Side virtual-card slips.

== Source and credit ==
The sheet credits the [[Players Committee|SWCCG Player’s Committee]] and prints 2003 in its footer. The immediate source is a retained recovery copy named <code>vs6-20050406.pdf</code>. Its original download and association with a historical Internet Archive locator have not been re-established.
